description: Defines the FakeProofSource class for testing ProofSource implementations in QUIC, including methods for intercepting proof and signature requests, managing callbacks, and replacing cryptographic components.

classes.name: FakeProofSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ProofSource for testing, capable of intercepting and controlling proof and signature requests.

classes.name: PendingOp
classes.description: Abstract base class for pending asynchronous operations in FakeProofSource.

classes.name: GetProofOp
classes.description: Represents a pending proof request operation.

classes.name: ComputeSignatureOp
classes.description: Represents a pending signature computation operation.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the FakeProofSource to intercept asynchronous calls.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Handles proof requests, either delegating or intercepting based on activation state.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes TLS signatures, possibly intercepting for testing.

methods.name: NumPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending callbacks.

methods.name: InvokePendingCallback
methods.description: Invokes a specific pending callback by index.
